lines.en: I turn through the water on my fins
My body is flat as a leaf
I swim along the edge of the waterweed
Three of us together, bright with color
I slip between two stalks

lines.zh: 我的条纹在水里一晃一晃
lines.en: My stripes waver in the water
The water is warm, I swim slowly
I follow the one ahead
One flick of my tail, and I turn
I steady myself with my pectoral fins
The waterweed closes over my head

lines.zh: 我朝更深一点的地方游
lines.en: I swim toward slightly deeper water
I slip through a gap in the stones
My shadow falls on the sand
I swim at the back of the group
The current carries me along
I rise a little
I loop around and come back
The water is quiet but for its own sound
I swim toward the light
I hover between two leaves
My stripes fold the light
I am still, and the water moves
The one beside me has stopped too

lines.zh: 我和同伴挤在一根水草边。
lines.en: My school crowds one weed.
This shade is just right
I cannot see the bank
The waterweed snagged me once

lines.zh: 泡升到水面，破了，我还在看。
lines.en: The bubble pops at the surface; I keep watching.
A few of us crowd together
Water passes over my gills
Three to five of us in the jungle water.
My colors are brighter in the water
A few of us nose to nose
What are you looking at from the bank
I look at you from the waterweed
Your shadow has darkened the water
Mine are stripes, not light

lines.zh: 丛林水里，我们三五条一起转。
lines.en: In jungle water, three or five of us turn.
Do not chase me

lines.zh: 我躲到水莲叶的阴影下。
lines.en: I hide under a lily pad's shadow.

lines.zh: 丛林的水面把你的影子拉长。
lines.en: The jungle water stretches your shadow.
Several of us are watching you
Are you coming in
I darted away at once
Two scales came off
The current rolled me over
I hide in the waterweed
That landed in the water
My gill covers flutter.
My tail is unsteady
The other fish scattered
When I open my mouth, water rushes in.

lines.zh: 我的条纹在浑浊里散开。
lines.en: My stripes blur in the murk.
The crumbs you scatter are swirling.
That is too small

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手指转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle your fingers once.
I will eat it once it lands in the water
I do not know this smell
Try dropping it in
I flick my tail and move off
There is food here already
I do not snatch

lines.zh: 你手上的东西我够不到
lines.en: I cannot reach what you hold
You touched my fin
I darted away
The water clouded up
I am very slippery

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了两片鳞
lines.en: That knocked off two scales
I slip past your hand
We bumped and scattered
Hiding in the water is easy

lines.zh: 我的尾巴擦过你的小腿。
lines.en: My tail brushes your calf.
Stop reaching in
I press back into the waterweed
Your hand is too slow in the water
A few of us always swim together
The same colors swim together
In the water it is hard to tell who is who

lines.zh: 靠近的时候会碰一下鳍
lines.en: We touch fins when we come close
The group gets longer as we swim
We need no leader
When the water is right, we all come
This waterweed belongs to all of us
Whoever falls behind just catches up
Tomorrow we will be in this same water
I nipped at it and missed
It is floating on the surface
Too small, I cannot see it
I carry it back to the school.
I am not good at picking things up

lines.zh: 那东西慢慢沉出我的视线。
lines.en: It sinks slowly out of my sight.
I nudge it with my mouth

lines.zh: 我把那粒沙子吐了出来。
lines.en: I spit the grain of sand out.
Things in the water belong to the water
I circled once and forgot about it
Something stirred in the water

lines.zh: 我用侧线感觉到了震动。
lines.en: I feel the tremor along my flank.
I turn toward the trail of bubbles.
I swim deeper
That is a shadow

lines.zh: 我身上的条纹反而露了我
lines.en: My stripes give me away
I will stay still first
The current changed direction
The others beside me hid
I should hide too
I swim along the waterweed

lines.zh: 我往深处去，你就看不见
lines.en: I go deeper where you cannot see
The weeds cover my colors

lines.zh: 我绕到你对面的石头后
lines.en: I slip behind the stone across from you
Behind the weeds, I am faster than you.
I move upstream a little
My tail stirs a little sand
I glide along the bottom
It is too bright up there
Once deep, I will stop
I butted you
That felt like a leaf slap
I sweep water with my tail
I have no teeth at all
I dart away and hide
My fin grazes your wrist.
I ram sideways once and flee.
A few of us scatter at once

lines.zh: 丛林水里，我们三五条一起。
lines.en: In jungle water, three or five of us together.
I swim away
Stripes and long fins cover me.
Three of us came together
This water's color is good
Sunlight reaches here
We form a small school
The water is clear, I can see far
There is enough waterweed to hide in
I wave my fins, looking for a spot
The light above flickers
This is our place now
The water heats up and I go lower

lines.zh: 我从水里被抛起来又落下
lines.en: I am thrown up out of the water and dropped

lines.zh: 水里没空气，可我一直在这里
lines.en: There is no air here, and I have always been here
The blast fills the water with bubbles

lines.zh: 飞来的东西擦破了我的条纹
lines.en: Something flying tore my stripes
That force chased me through the water

lines.zh: 水里没有吃的，我饿得发虚
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the water, I go faint
Lightning turns the whole stream white.
There is no waterweed in the void
